data.title: AMTD IDEA, AMTD Digital and TGE Jointly Announce the Injection of Four Premium Hotel Assets into TGE
data.description:
PARIS and NEW YORK and LONDON, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AMTD IDEA Group (; ), a NYSE and SGX-ST dual-listed company and a subsidiary of AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (), a controlled and consolidated subsidiary of AMTD IDEA Group, and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (; ), a controlled and consolidated subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly announced today the injection of four premium hotel assets into TGE.

On October 21, 2026, AMTD Digital and TGE entered into an Asset Transfer and Share Issuance Agreement (the "Asset Transfer Agreement"), pursuant to which AMTD Digital transferred, on November 2, 2026 to TGE its controlling interests in four hotel assets, consisting of 100% of the AMTD IDEA Tribeca Hotel, a 50% equity interest with veto power in the hotel operations of the Ritz-Carlton, Perth, and 100% of AMTD Dao By Dorsett Hornsey London, and 80% of Upper Regalia Kuala Lumpur (collectively, the "Target Assets"), for an aggregate purchase price of US$209,766,000, factoring into consideration also the underlying debts.

The L'Officiel Coffee and Bar celebrated its official opening at City of Dreams in Macao SAR in September 2026. As the Brand's second global location, it reinforces our commitment to a strategic expansion plan within the hospitality sector, with a target of establishing 15 to 20 additional venues worldwide.

The purchase price was satisfied in full by the issuance by TGE to AMTD Digital on November 2, 2026 of 198,630,381 newly issued Class A ordinary shares of TGE (the "Consideration Shares"), determined based on the 30-day volume-weighted average price of TGE's shares on the New York Stock Exchange for the thirty trading days ending on May 29, 2026. The Asset Transfer Agreement was entered into immediately after AMTD IDEA Group transferred the Target Assets into AMTD Digital at the valuation and through settlement and discharge of US$209,766,000 of indebtedness owed by AMTD IDEA Group to AMTD Digital (collectively, the "Transactions").

The Transactions are intended to inject and consolidate the group's premium hospitality assets under TGE, which focuses on hospitality and VIP services, among other businesses focusing into lifestyle and experiencing.

After the consummation of the Transactions and as of the date of this press release, (i) AMTD Digital holds 88.2% of the issued and outstanding share capital of TGE, representing 91.1% of the total outstanding voting power of TGE, and (ii) AMTD IDEA Group, directly and through AMTD Digital, beneficially owns 95.6% of the issued and outstanding share capital of TGE, representing 96.7% of the total outstanding voting power of TGE.

About AMTD Group

AMTD Group is a conglomerate with a core business portfolio spanning across media and entertainment, education and training, and premium assets and hospitality sectors.

About AMTD IDEA Group

AMTD IDEA Group (; ) represents a diversified institution and digital solutions conglomerate group, connecting companies and investors with global markets. Its comprehensive one-stop business services plus digital solutions platform addresses different clients' diverse and inter-connected business needs and digital requirements across all phases of their life cycles. AMTD IDEA Group is uniquely positioned as an active super connector between clients, business partners, investee companies, and investors, connecting the East and the West. For more information, please visit www.amtdinc.com or follow us on X (formerly known as "Twitter") at @AMTDGroup.

About AMTD Digital Inc.

AMTD Digital Inc. () is a comprehensive digital solutions platform headquartered in France. Its one-stop digital solutions platform operates key business lines including digital media, content and marketing services, investments as well as hospitality and VIP services. For AMTD Digital's announcements, please visit https://ir.amtdigital.net/investor-news.

About The Generation Essentials Group

The Generation Essentials Group (; ), jointly established by AMTD Group, AMTD IDEA Group (; ) and AMTD Digital Inc. (), is headquartered in France and focuses on global strategies and developments in multi-media, entertainment, and cultural affairs worldwide as well as hospitality and VIP services. TGE comprises L'Officiel, The Art Newspaper, movie and entertainment projects. Collectively, TGE is a diversified portfolio of media and entertainment businesses, and a global portfolio of premium properties. Also, TGE is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) sponsor manager, with its first SPAC successfully raised and priced on December 18, 2025.

data.title: Stagwell Inc. (STGW) Reports Equity Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description:
NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 6, 2026 / Stagwell Inc. (the "Company") announced today the grant of equity inducement awards. Effective November 5, 2026, the Company granted a total of 9,453 restricted stock units to 7 new employees. Each restricted stock unit represents the right to receive one share of the Company's Class A common stock. The restricted stock units will vest in two installments, with one-third vesting on the second anniversary of the grant date and two-thirds vesting on the third anniversary of the grant date. The restricted stock units are subject to accelerated vesting upon (i) termination of employment by the Company without Cause or (ii) death or disability. The Company granted these awards as a material inducement to employment in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

Stagwell is the global challenger network transforming marketing through AI. We deliver scaled creative performance for the world's most ambitious brands, connecting culture-moving creativity with leading-edge technology to harmonize the art and science of marketing. Led by entrepreneurs, our specialists in 40+ countries are unified under a single purpose: to drive effectiveness and improve business results for our clients. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

data.title: DraftKings shares fall sharply, ending six-session winning streak
data.description:
DraftKings (NASDAQ: snapped its six-session winning streak on Friday, with shares falling 25.85% to $17.44 in afternoon trading.

Despite Friday's decline, the stock had gained 15.85% over the preceding six sessions, compared with a 5.04% decline in the S&P 500 Index. Year-to-date, DKNG has fallen 50.38%, while the broader index has gained 7.43%.

The selloff followed the company's Q3 results, with revenue rising 16% year-over-year to $1.33B but missing the $1.39B analyst consensus. Non-GAAP EPS came in at -$0.53, missing expectations by $0.28, while adjusted EBITDA recorded a loss of $316.9M against the expected loss of $65.9M.

Despite the earnings miss, monthly unique paying customers increased 13% year-over-year to 4.1M. Sports revenue grew 31.5% to $783.6M, while iGaming revenue rose 2.1% to $460.9M.

Looking ahead, DraftKings lowered its FY2026 revenue  outlook to $6.35B-$6.55B, below the $6.65B analyst consensus, with adjusted EBITDA of $175M-$275M. For FY2027, it projects revenue of $7.35B-$7.75B and adjusted EBITDA of $800M-$1B, while planning to invest $650M-$700M in its Predictions business in FY2026.

Despite the recent weakness, Seeking Alpha analyst Caffital Research maintained a bullish view on DraftKings in September, citing its stable sports-betting market share and rapid growth in its Predictions business. The analyst estimated 54% upside, with a price target of $32.60.

According to Seeking Alpha's Quant ratings, DraftKings carries a Hold rating with a score of 3.05 out of 5, receiving an A+ for growth, C- for profitability, and D- for valuation.

Wall Street sentiment remained strongly bullish, with the average analyst rating at Strong Buy (4.50/5). Of the 36 analysts covering the stock, 30 rated it Buy or Strong Buy, five assigned a Hold rating, and one gave it a Sell rating.

Seeking Alpha analysts remained cautious, maintaining a Hold rating with an average score of 3.40 out of 5.

data.title: UCO Bank fined Rs.15,000 for delay in revising widow's family pension despite official instructions: Here's what happened
data.description:
New Delhi, Nov. 6 -- The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Chandigarh has directed UCO Bank to pay Rs.15,000 in compensation to a widow for failing to revise her family pension despite receiving instructions from the disbursing authorities, according to a report by The Tribune.

The commission held the bank responsible for deficiency in service, noting that the delay caused the complainant hardship and mental harassment. It rejected the bank's defence that it had subsequently cleared the pending arrears, observing that the family's suffering during the period of delay could not be overlooked.

The complaint was filed by Rupnagar resident Sukhwinder Singh on behalf of his mother, Prakash Kaur. Her husband, Nasib Singh, had retired from the Chandigarh Transport Undertaking (CTU) on March 31, 1995, and his pension was sanctioned in accordance with the applicable rules.

Following his death on November 28, 2001, the family pension was transferred to Prakash Kaur with effect from November 29, 2001. However, subsequent revisions to the pension were allegedly not implemented correctly.

The complainant alleged that despite several communications from the pension-sanctioning authorities, repeated visits to the UCO Bankbranch in Rupnagar and formal representations, the bank failed to release the revised family pension and other admissible benefits.

These included the applicable old-age allowance, Leave Travel Concession (LTC) benefits and revised medical allowances.

During the proceedings, the bank's counsel argued that UCO Bank had no role in sanctioning or determining the pension and was only responsible for maintaining the pension account and facilitating withdrawals.

The bank denied any deliberate delay or deficiency in service, maintaining that the delay was bona fide and occurred during the recalculation and verification of the pension claim.

However, the commission observed that the bank corrected the pension structure and released the accumulated arrears only after the consumer complaint had been filed.

Dismissing the bank's defence, the commission highlighted the repeated efforts made by the complainant to secure the pensionary benefits due to her mother.

"The complainant had to make repeated visits, representations, and also serve legal notices to get the pensionary benefits due to her. The delay certainly caused inconvenience, hardship and mental harassment. Merely because the arrears were subsequently paid, the hardship suffered cannot be ignored," it said, as per the report.

The commission concluded that the bank's deficiency in service stood established and directed the Branch Manager of UCO Bank's Rupnagar branch to pay Rs.15,000 in compensation to the complainant.

data.title: Fox completes $22B purchase of Roku (update)
data.description:
Fox announced it completed its $22 billion purchase of Roku Inc. .

Roku founder Anthony Wood will join the FOX board. He will also serve as Co-Chair, FOX Digital Platforms, the newly formed division that includes Roku, Tubi, FOX One, Red Seat Ventures, and other digital products and services across the company, alongside Paul Cheesbrough, who assumes the role of Co-Chair and CEO, FOX Digital Platforms.

"The closing of this acquisition advances the long-term strategy of FOX," Fox CEO Lachlan Murdoch said in a  statement on Friday. "Beginning today, our top priority for the combined company is to continue to relentlessly serve audiences and partners, while reinforcing the openness and choice that is the essence of the Roku platform."

Under the terms of the deal agreement, Roku stockholders are entitled to receive $95.30 in cash and 0.9799 shares of FOX Class A common stock for each share of Roku Class A and Roku Class B common stock they owned immediately prior to closing.

The deal terms on Friday were slightly changed from the original terms in June, where FOX agreed to pay $96.00 in cash and 0.9693 shares of FOX Class A  common stock for each Roku Class A and Class B share outstanding

Allen & Company served as lead financial advisor to FOX. Morgan Stanley served as a financial advisor to FOX, and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding led the debt financing for the transaction. Goldman Sach also served as a financial advisor to FOX. Weil, Gotshal & Manges LLP served as legal counsel to FOX.

Qatalyst Partners served as exclusive financial advisor to Roku, and Goodwin Procter LLP and Axinn LLP served as legal counsel to Roku.

data.title: Stonegate Capital Partners Updates Coverage on Aemetis Inc. (AMTX) 3Q26
data.description:
Dallas, Texas--(Newsfile Corp. - November 6, 2026) - Aemetis Inc. : Stonegate Capital Partners Updates Coverage on Aemetis Inc. . Aemetis' 3Q26 results strengthened the operating case as higher RNG credit values increased earnings from existing assets. The $11.0M first-half 45Z catchup amplified profits, but recurring economics also improved. Most MVR benefits are now expected in 2H27, extending the funding period before Keyes delivers its next earnings step. Financing terms and cash retained after investment should determine how much improvement reaches shareholders.

To view the full announcement, including downloadable images, bios, and more, click here.

Key Takeaways:

  • 3Q26 showed the earnings power of assets already built. Revenue rose 49% y/y to $88.2M, adjusted EBITDA reached $24.8M, and Aemetis posted its first quarterly net income of $5.2M. The $11.0M first-half 45Z catch-up helped, but recurring economics also stepped up. Excluding it, RNG 45Z revenue was $9.1M for the quarter after the federal model update lifted the credit to ~$62/MMBtu. RNG volume rose 39% y/y, two digesters entered service in October, and six more LCFS pathways are nearing approval. That is growth from existing output, without the full long-term buildout.
  • Keyes has two near-term margin levers. The MVR system has all key equipment on site and construction targeted for completion around March 2027. Management maintains an ~$32M annual cash-flow opportunity: natural-gas savings begin at switchover, and most of the benefit lands in 2H27. The third corn-oil unit, scheduled for December, completes a program expected to roughly double corn-oil output vs. 1Q26 into a stronger price environment.
  • Multiple dated catalysts over the next 12 months. RNG fueling station deliveries to truck fleets are scheduled to begin in November. California's year-round E15 implementation is slated for January 1, 2027. EU export approvals for India biodiesel are expected in 4Q. Thirteen cleanup and compression units are in hand for the next 13 digesters. Higher 45Z and LCFS economics, together with refinancing and a potential minority India IPO, could drive meaningful margin expansion, cash-flow improvement and valuation upside.
